|lore=Jabba makes offers one cannot refuse. Smugglers, thieves and competitors who do not acquiesce have been rumored to wake up with a bantha’s head in their bed.
|game_text=Deploy on one of your gangsters or bounty hunters. Once during each of your control phases, if present with an opponent's smuggler or character of ability = 1, may use 3 Force. Opponent must use 5 Force or that character returns to opponent's hand.
|joke="Offers one cannot refuse" and the bantha's head in the bed copy Vito Corleone's "offer he can't refuse" and the horse's head in the bed from ''The Godfather'' (1972). See [[Jokes#Jabba's Influence|Jokes]].
